description: Say how a Texas electrician license renews, for a license type and the months since it expired. Returns the window, the fee, the method (online, mail or reapply), and the forms to send.

expired_months.description: Months since expiration. 0 or less means not expired.

expires.description: Optional expiration date, YYYY-MM-DD, to add the three fee step dates.

type.description: License type name or page slug.
